title: Angular Position Response of a Rotating Machine to Constant Torque
expert_review: A rigorous problem illustrating how constant torque leads to linearly growing angular position and highlights the distinction between velocity and position responses.
source: Control Systems Textbook - Chapter 3, Problem P3.54
learning_objectives: Derive angular position from torque inputs using Laplace transforms
Handle repeated poles in inverse Laplace transformations
Distinguish transient and steady-state components in mechanical systems
Interpret unbounded steady-state behavior in rotational motion
